status_summary: On 2025-09-23 EPA published a proposed rule to revise the 2024 TSCA risk evaluation procedures. It would restore separate risk determinations for each condition of use, delete the 2024 statement that EPA will not exclude conditions of use, allow exclusion of exposure pathways handled under other statutes, and, according to a law firm summary, take into account available information on engineering controls and protective equipment in occupational scenarios. Comments closed 2025-11-07. A law firm article said EPA planned to publish the final rule in April 2026, but no final rule was found in the Federal Register through 2026-10-13.
